_comment: Authored, purpose-implying prop clusters (bible sec2 P3: do not dump props everywhere). Structures from the Quaternius Fantasy Props MegaKit (docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md), placed by scripts/world/props.gd: each entry is stood on the ground by asking the world (D09), given a box collider from its combined mesh AABB, and scaled by its own `scale` -- the pack is authored close to real-world size so most entries sit near 1.0. ALL TUNABLE.
_comment_layout: work_area sits south-west of the village square's workshop [2,2] (EV6: the Medieval Village workshop stands where the old farm-pack Barn stood, its open arch bay facing this cluster so the nook reads as the workshop's own yard) -- a smithing/repair nook implying someone maintains the settlement's tools, far enough from the workshop's footprint and the Quarry Foreman NPC [0,-6] to read as its own spot rather than clutter. farmhouse_yard sits south of Grandpa's house [-22,-16] -- storage and harvest overflow for a farm that feeds itself. Grandpa's house is a real footprint, not just its terrain pad (grandpa_house.gd: INNER_W 9.0/INNER_D 7.0/WALL_T 0.3 -> half_w 4.8, half_d 3.8, so the house's own south wall sits at z=-19.8) -- an earlier placement here landed props inside that wall; kept 4m+ clear of it now, and still off the house's east-facing door lane (tested by smoke_opening, x -16..-9.7 at z~-15).
_comment_layout_ev7r: EV7-remainder: the two of the bible's remaining three named clusters that had real geography to sit on. trainer_camp sits inside the practice-meadow clearing (vegetation.json, [30,-40] r16) but off route 2's path (terrain_playground.json, [18,-24]->[30,-40]) near [26,-28] -- a waypoint on the way to the arena, not inside it. bridge_repair_site sits on the footbridge's own west bank (village.json's footbridge, EV6-remainder, [-136.3,113] yaw -5) near [-141.7,114] -- see _comment_layout_ev7fix below for the current exact siting of both, which moved from EV7-remainder's own first numbers. quarry_station is NOT built here -- no quarry exists anywhere in the world (village_npcs.json's Quarry Foreman still stands in the square for exactly that reason) and building one is out of scope for a prop-placement item; left open, same as EV6-remainder left it.
_comment_layout_ev7fix: EV7-clusters-fix: a placement-only round after a genuine blind critic read the shipped state and failed trainer_camp outright ('reads as three container props at even spacing... scatter-list output, not a place') while passing bridge_repair_site's purpose but naming real composition defects (EV7-remainder-critique's own DONE.md entry had self-graded both as passing without ever running a real blind pass -- that self-grade is overturned here, honestly, not quietly dropped). trainer_camp drops `Bench` (a trestle table nothing was ever resting ON, since props.gd places every prop flush to the ground with no way to stack one on another -- the crate/sack/barrel all passed clean through its legs) and re-spaces the remaining three with real, uneven gaps. bridge_repair_site's whole cluster moves ~3m to hug the footbridge's actual west landing (tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd, bridge local frame) instead of sitting in open lawn off to the side of it, the axe gets a genuine lean via props.gd's new `pitch_deg`, and the rope moves to the crate's bridge-facing side instead of being tucked behind it. All positions in this pass were checked against real Terrain3D height data and the actual placed footbridge/mill transforms via tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd, not hand-estimated.

props._why: the cluster's anchor -- an anvil mounted on its own stump
faces the anvil across the nook -- pulled in 0.7m (round 1 blind critic: the anvil/whetstone and crate/workbench read as two separate groups, not one station)
a sharpening stone within reach of the bench -- pulled in 0.4m, same reason
stock crate behind the anvil -- pulled in 0.9m, same reason
a tool left leaning, mid-repair -- pulled in 0.3m, same reason
the cluster's anchor -- overflow from the last harvest

set right against the barrel's side, not just nearby -- round 2 blind critic: a loose arc of props near a wall reads as dumped, not a task. This is meant to read as one pile: a load just carried out and set down together.

touching the barrel's other side, tipped at an angle rather than square -- just set down, not arranged. FarmCrate_Carrot swapped out earlier (round 1 blind critic): its vertex-colour-tinted contents render as an unreadable white/grey smear, a model defect not a placement one.
in front of the pile, facing back toward it -- the tool that did the carrying, set down after
the big piece of the same load, closing the pile from the front

EV7-clusters-fix: the cluster's anchor -- a travelling trainer's pack, dropped beside the practice-meadow path, kept as its own separate stop rather than crammed against the supply pile (a genuine blind critic on the shipped state: 'reads as three container props at even spacing... scatter-list output, not a place'). Sited off route 2 ([18,-24]->[30,-40], terrain_playground.json), inside the practice-meadow clearing (vegetation.json, centre [30,-40] r16) but well short of the arena itself.

EV7-clusters-fix: the pile's anchor. This meadow slopes here for real -- a corner-height probe against the crate's own exact footprint (tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd) measures 0.137-0.172m of spread across the headings tried, barely moved by yaw alone (165deg: 0.137m vs the old -25deg heading's 0.145m -- yaw was never going to fix this on its own). `sink_m` 0.08 is what actually settles it: added to the model's own ~0.05m embed, the crate's rigid bottom sits ~0.13m below the sampled centre height, which is deeper than half this footprint's worst-case corner spread, so every corner ends up buried in the terrain mesh rather than floating above it, regardless of which way it's turned. `Bench` (a trestle table) is DROPPED entirely -- the critic's own offered alternative ('drop the table and commit to a supply cache at a waypoint composition'): props.gd places every prop flush to the ground with no way to rest one ON another, so the table's flat top could never actually hold the crate/sack/barrel it was meant to -- they always passed clean through its legs. A cache of things set down together, not a furnished stop, is what this system can honestly build.

EV7-clusters-fix: touching the crate's side (0.83m centre-to-centre, matching the two footprints' combined radius) so the pair reads as one pile someone set down together, not a scatter -- distinct spacing from the pack 1.9m away, breaking the old even 3-way spacing the critic named as 'placed by script.' Still the plain supply barrel, not the farmhouse's apple-branded one.

EV7-clusters-fix: the cluster's anchor, moved to hug the footbridge's own west landing (tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd -- bridge local frame x=-5.3, z=1.4, just outside the deck/rail collider's z=+/-1.05 half-extent and past the stone abutment tile at local x=-3.9..-5.9) instead of sitting marooned in open lawn ~3m further out (a genuine blind critic on the shipped state: 'marooned ~6m from the house and ~4m off the bridge head in open lawn'). `sink_m` buries the crate's own shallow 0.05m embed a little further so grass doesn't show lit up under its skirt -- this spot is flat (0.000-0.006m corner spread, real terrain data, not sloped), so the old 'floating crate' complaint here was the shallow embed, not a slope.

EV7-clusters-fix: actually leaning against the crate's near face now, not standing bolt upright ('the axe LEVITATES: bolt upright, unsupported, haft ending mid-air'). This model is authored vertical in its own glTF (a baked -90deg node rotation puts its long axis on Y regardless of yaw -- confirmed with tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd, not guessed), so no yaw value could ever lay it down; `pitch_deg` is new on scripts/world/props.gd for exactly this. Anchor and pitch picked from the same probe's world-space AABB check so the tilted mesh's low end sits in the grass and its body actually overlaps the crate's east face (~0.05m real contact, not just visually adjacent), clear of the crate's own footprint so it doesn't clip through a corner.

EV7-clusters-fix: moved to the crate's own east/bridge-facing side, in front rather than tucked behind it ('the rope coil -- the most purpose-carrying prop -- is 90% hidden behind the crate'). This is the side a player sees first walking off the bridge, so the repair stock reads immediately instead of needing to walk around the crate to find it.

EV7-clusters-fix: water bucket at the pile's far (west) side, foot of the pile -- kept off the deck/rail collider the same way the rest of the cluster is now (local z 1.75, not 0.89 like the position this replaced, which was inside the walkway's own collider footprint).

clusters.name: quarry_station
clusters._why: SD16, and the cluster EV7-remainder listed as still unbuilt and left to this item. The Old Quarry's own working face, abandoned mid-shift: the gear a crew leaves when the work stops rather than when it finishes. It sits on the quarry floor between the two foundations and the conduit head, so the walk in reads working face -> old foundations -> Team Tether hardware, which is the order §32's reveal ladder wants that rung told in. Every model is one the settlement already uses (D24, one prop family); nothing here is new.

props._why: the cluster's anchor -- a crate of cut stone still standing where it was filled
set against the first crate's side, not merely near it -- EV7-clusters-fix's own finding: a loose arc of props reads as dumped, a touching pile reads as one load
water for the crew, kept with the load
leaning where it was set down, pitched off vertical against the rock -- the one prop in the cluster that names the work, and the reason the player's own pickaxe is the tool the rootstone wants
tipped over a couple of paces off the pile, so the group has an edge instead of a boundary
somebody's pack, still here -- the detail that makes the site abandoned rather than merely disused

SITE-DRESSING: cut-face spoil, largest of the set, between the working pile and the conduit head (404,1804) -- what a quarry actually leaves is broken rock, not four identical boulders on a lawn. Same textured Rock_Medium family band1's fire ring already proved through props.gd (environment/nature's own untextured rock pack is the one that fails, per that band's own record).

SITE-DRESSING: second spoil piece, deliberately a different model AND a different scale/rotation band from its neighbour -- the two-identical-rocks-at-near-identical-rotation defect this pass exists to fix.
SITE-DRESSING: spoil at the foot of the north-west foundation (397,1805) -- rubble a crew clearing that ruin's own footing would have piled here, not carried off.
SITE-DRESSING: smaller chip toward the second foundation (404,1794), the one piece in this set scaled as debris rather than a boulder -- extraction leaves a size gradient, not one repeated stone.

SITE-DRESSING: closes the working face's own cut-face read -- set behind the crate pile from the approach so the crew reads as having worked INTO the rock, not merely stacked crates on grass beside it.

_comment_ow5d: OW5D: bridge_repair_site and quarry_station relocated by the same deltas as the mill footbridge and Old Quarry they dress (docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2), so they do not strand at the structures old, now-empty coordinates. work_area, farmhouse_yard and trainer_camp are unmoved village/practice-meadow clusters (section 10.1, unmoved by design).
